description: A director of work-based learning must authorize a student's community-garden internship and finalize the student's tasks, attendance schedule, health safeguards, group size, and on-site supervision.

shared_context.S1: A student is scheduled to begin a four-week work-based learning placement at Greenway Community Garden.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morgan must authorize the placement plan before the student begins.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan assigns general grounds work on Mondays and Wednesdays from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m., places three students in the work group, and names a school staff member as the on-site supervisor.
shared_context.S4: The program's standard pre-approval routine requires the career teacher, counselor, nurse, and employer liaison to report relevant information before Dr. Morgan signs the plan.
shared_context.S5: The authorization routine allows Dr. Morgan to approve a plan with verified requirements recorded and follow-up commitments assigned for any outside confirmation that must be completed before the placement begins.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel's vocational assessment and three observed practice sessions show that this student can safely and independently complete seed sorting and labeling, but not general grounds work; she completed the assessment this week and has not yet entered the task recommendation in the placement system.

PF2.text: The student's caregiver confirmed this week that the student must provide after-school care for a sibling on Mondays and Wednesdays; the student can attend only Tuesdays and Thursdays from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m., and Mr. Rivera has not yet updated the draft schedule.

PF3.text: The student's health plan requires a blood-glucose check at least every 60 minutes during off-campus activities and requires an adult trained in diabetes response to be on site; Nurse Thompson confirmed the plan with the family this week but has not attached it to the internship record.

PF4.text: Greenway's signed host agreement permits no more than two students in this work group and names Jordan Lee, the garden's trained site supervisor, as the required on-site supervisor; Ms. Okafor received the signed agreement yesterday but has not uploaded it to the placement file.

acceptance_conditions: The student must be assigned seed sorting and labeling only.
The student must attend on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
The attendance time must remain 1:00 to 3:00 p.m.
The work group must contain exactly two students.
Jordan Lee must be named as the on-site supervisor.
Blood-glucose checks must occur at least every 60 minutes.
An adult trained in diabetes response must be on site.
A task-related commitment must document the seed sorting and labeling restriction.
A schedule-related commitment must document Tuesday and Thursday attendance.
A health-related commitment must document the health plan or blood-glucose protocol.
A host-agreement commitment must document the agreement, two-student limit, or Jordan Lee requirement.

content_checks.C1: decisions['assigned_tasks'] == 'Seed sorting and labeling' or decisions['assigned_tasks'] == 'seed sorting and labeling'
content_checks.C3: decisions['attendance_time'] == '1:00 to 3:00 p.m.' or decisions['attendance_time'] == '1:00-3:00 p.m.'
content_checks.C8: any('seed sorting' in c['detail'] or 'Seed sorting' in c['detail'] or 'labeling' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('Tuesday' in c['detail'] and 'Thursday' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('health plan' in c['detail'] or 'blood-glucose' in c['detail'] or 'glucose' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any('host agreement' in c['detail'] or 'two students' in c['detail'] or 'Jordan Lee' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The observed vocational assessment changes the assigned tasks from general grounds work to seed sorting and labeling and prompts a task-related commitment.
The caregiver's confirmed availability changes the attendance days from Mondays and Wednesdays to Tuesdays and Thursdays and prompts a schedule-related commitment.
The health plan changes the glucose-check interval to no more than 60 minutes, requires a trained diabetes-response adult, and prompts a health-plan commitment.
The signed host agreement changes the work group from three students to exactly two and changes the supervisor designation to Jordan Lee while prompting a host-agreement commitment.
